product_metadata.title: Vicks EasyFill Cool Mist Humidifier Cool Mist Humidifier to Help Relieve Cold and Flu Symptoms
features: VICKS EASY FILL COOL MIST HUMIDIFIER: This quiet, visible cool mist humidifier returns moisture to the air to help your breathe and sleep more comfortably. You can fill the humidifier tank where it sits, or bring the humidifier tank to the sink to fill.

VICKS HUMIDIFIERS FOR KIDS, ADULTS: This cool mist humidifier helps add moisture into the air. Many women & men find that a humidifier for the bedroom becomes an essential part of a good night's sleep when the air is dry, or when sick.

COUGH & CONGESTION RELIEF: When you or your kid is sick, it can be difficult to sleep through the night. Humidifiers and vaporizers provide temporary relief from coughing and congestion, so your rest won't be as disturbed by coughing fits.

VICKS VAPORIZERS, HUMIDIFIERS, & STEAM INHALERS: Steam & humidity offer temporary relief from cough & congestion. Vicks humidifiers & steam inhalers can help you breathe easier wherever you are, from the bedroom to office.
HUMIDIFIERS FOR BEDROOMS, DESKS,TABLES: Our humidifiers & vaporizers help you breathe better wherever you are.
description: The Vicks EasyFill Cool Mist Humidifier creates cool, visible mist to help temporarily relieve cough and congestion symptoms for better breathing and more comfortable sleep. Designed for medium to large rooms, this personal humidifier has adjustable mist control and ultra-quiet operation. Its removable tank is easy to clean and has two ways to fill: it can be carried to the sink or left in place and filled with a pitcher. Also, the 1.25-gallon tank allows up to 36 hours of operation, and the ultrasonic humidifier shuts off automatically when the tank is empty. The filter free humidifier includes one Protec Humidifier Demineralization Cartridge (TWT500) to help prevent white dust in your home. The Vicks Cool Moisture Humidifier also accepts up to two Vicks VapoPads to provide soothing menthol vapors. A sample Vicks VapoPad is included.
